name: Guts
summary: Poker-related in-or-out pot game where players simultaneously choose to contest each hand and losers match the pot.
rules_text: Each round begins with all players anteing to seed a pot. For each deal, deal 2, 3 or 4 hole cards (game chosen beforehand) from a standard deck. All players simultaneously declare in or out, e.g. by showing a chip for in. All out players sit out this showdown. In players reveal hands and rank by poker ranking adapted to hand size; pair beats high card and in basic 2-card no straights or flushes. Highest in hand wins the current pot. Every other in player must match the pot size into the next pot, so the pot doubles or more. All players including previous outs ante again only via carry over and are dealt again. The deal sequence repeats until exactly one player declares in; that player wins the pot uncontested and the round ends.
